card.name: Lab and metabolic findings in warnings
card.fires_on: Words that lead into lab or metabolic findings in safety text, such as "laboratory" after "clinically significant" and "metabolic" before "changes". Also fires inside fenofibrate and before a lipid profile.

modes.label: Laboratory abnormalities
modes.description: The word laboratory or abnormalities after "clinically significant" in adverse event statements.
modes.example: and no clinically significant abnormalities in<< laboratory>> safety tests were observed.

modes.label: Metabolic changes
modes.description: The word metabolic in antipsychotic warnings about metabolic changes.

modes.label: Fenofibrate and lipid monitoring
modes.description: The middle of the drug name fenofibrate, or the word before a fasting lipid profile.
modes.example: obtain<< a>> fasting lipid profile at baseline and monitor periodically
